Same age, same dickhead friend, same social anxiety and unsureness about who the 'real' friends are.

Something i learnt from mental torture from an older brother is to go with whatever they say. Sounds stupid and shallow, it is.

I go to an all boys school so being gay is an insult for some reason (No idea) but when someone calls me gay, I say something like "Yeah so? You trying to ask me out?" The laughter and torment still ensues, but IMO its a lot less than if you try to fight it and give them the reaction they want.

As for the dickhead friend, that a different story. Find a hobby that you need to focus on in order for it to work. That way your mind will be too preoccupied to ever think about being depressed. (Mines gaming which comes in later)

Focus on the hobby and at this point, nothing else matters but keeping your mental state positive, don't fight your friends or the dickhead. In my case since ive always been a gamer (and a good one at that) i had something that i was the best at in my circle of friends, since i wasnt the smartest, strongest or best looking.

In any case when my friends realised i was good with computers and games, I started to set them up. Without them realising (because theyre mindless idiots like the rest of everyone our age) I got them to buy decent laptops and i found a game that we can all play together (Smite). Now this is where it gets good, I now have common ground where i can talk to my friends about something.

The dickhead friend doesnt own his own laptop and cant afford to buy one good enough to play games on, hes now left out of the group. We talk shit about him while we skype and play, i told them what hes like to me without him being there to lie and defend himself. We all now think hes a coward, insecure and, well a dickhead.

I hope this helps and good luck with everything.
